data.description:
## Context / Problem

The plan-review gate is reached through three surfaces: the CLI (`rebar review-plan`), the library (`rebar.llm.plan_review.review_plan`, `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py:199`), and the MCP tools, including the async `review_plan_start` + poll pair (`src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py:268`) with its de-dup and `GATE_CONGESTED` behaviour. The epic requires all of them to work under both engines.

## Approach

Thread the optional `engine` argument (ADR 0123 precedence: explicit argument over `[verify] plan_review_engine` over `"pipeline"`) through each surface into `review_plan`: a `--engine {pipeline,agentic}` CLI flag, the library keyword the switch ticket adds, and an optional `engine` parameter on `review_plan`, `review_plan_start` and the synchronous MCP tool. The MCP de-dup key includes the resolved engine, so a pipeline run and an agentic run on the same ticket are distinct jobs rather than one attaching to the other; gate admission (`gate_admission`, ADR 0112) is unchanged, so `GATE_CONGESTED` behaves identically. `docs/mcp-reference.md` and the CLI help document the parameter. Passing one argument down an existing call chain is the least change that gives every surface the switch.

## Scope

- the `review-plan` CLI command module (flag)
- src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py (tool parameters, de-dup key)
- docs/mcp-reference.md, docs/plan-review-gate.md
- tests/unit/test_plan_review_engine_surfaces.py (new)

## Testing

- Each surface, with `FakeRunner`, under each engine: CLI flag, library keyword, MCP sync tool, and `review_plan_start` followed by `plan_review_status` and `gate_status`, each returning the same verdict shape with the engine recorded.
- De-dup: two concurrent same-ticket starts with the same engine attach to one job; with different engines they are two jobs.
- Congestion: with admission at capacity, the agentic engine returns `GATE_CONGESTED` exactly as the pipeline does.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] CLI, library, MCP synchronous and MCP async start/poll surfaces run under both engines, pinned by `tests/unit/test_plan_review_engine_surfaces.py`.
- [ ] De-dup and `GATE_CONGESTED` behaviour under the agentic engine match the pipeline, pinned by the same file.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
data.title: Engine parity across CLI, library and MCP sync/async plan-review surfaces
